item.text:
<linkedin_post>Google’s TB screening research began with a 2019 benchmark showing that a deep learning model could detect signs of active pulmonary TB on chest X-rays at performance levels matching experienced radiologists. A prospective, multi-site validation followed in 2024.

Nexus AI then developed the algorithms into a clinical tool, with work to support different X-ray machines, offline use and clinical workflows. The company also obtained EU Class IIb medical device certification and ISO 13485 certification for its quality management system.

The tool is now being deployed in approximately 40 healthcare facilities across six countries. It can screen an X-ray in as little as 45 seconds, helping clinicians identify patients who need follow-up testing.</linkedin_post>
